_note: Russian; see topbar.json. The inspector at the right of the Edit view: its tabs (the object’s own, Box, Animation), the theme slide and stage layout panels, the fields, menus, buttons and hover texts. Labels sit in a narrow column (Capitalisation, Scaling and Line Transform in 104 points), so they are kept short. A box on a slide is блок; build (an object coming on and going off) is анимация. The captions in capitals (LAYOUT, THEME SLIDE, OBJECT, SLIDE NOTES, SELECTED WORDS, THE WHOLE BOX) are capitals here too: the app draws them as written.
